field_evidence.guidance: HM Land Registry developing estates: plan requirements and surveying specification (PG41s5)
field_evidence.plot_extent_requirement: plan must clearly define the extent of each plot and show the number or reference identifying it
field_evidence.public_geometry_availability: guidance is public/no-login but does not publish approved development plot geometries or a canonical parcel materialization feed
field_evidence.purpose: technical specification for plans lodged for estate boundary approval and estate plan approval
field_evidence.separate_parcel_requirement: where a property comprises more than one parcel, each parcel must be distinguished by a different reference
field_evidence.survey_requirement: plan must be based on an accurate survey and relate proposed development to registered-title boundaries
